account.md: sessions say what may not be done before it is tried, a sign-in confirmed by its own call, the banner following the sessions; registration is offered where the hub registers or the invitation admits; signed in the theme is set in Your account, the header menu only signed out; a sensitive call asks for the password or a code where it stands, then is made again, every route that asks called through it, held by a list the hub test and the check share; the meat-proxy hint quotes the hub's note from /me, no text of its own; the registration form names the hub's terms, linked only when plain https; the meat-proxy switch with its two parts under it, each sent alone, drawn from the hub's answer; forge access a tab of the account's Security, also at /settings/forge, a project's settings say which grant reads its repository; the mail address on the notifications page, the password beside it optional, a held change led to the sessions; when mail goes out sends only what changed, the browser's zone only offered; the account in tabs at addresses of their own, the old addresses led to their tab, a new view from the page's top
admin.md: the instance admin area one section at a time, Registration and a report reached by an address of their own; abuse reports a section of /admin, the snapshot as text, a suspension asked first; the limits per person a number, no limit where the contract has it, or the default, the environment's locked; registration in the admin area says what is missing beside the fields, a block is lifted by its typed address; a decision on a waiting account refreshes the counts, not the registration form; the landing page imported and exported as JSON in its editor, an import checked by the preview call and saved only by Save; landing variants edited one at a time in the landing editor, campaigns beside the privacy hint, their counts in Statistics
agents.md: the Agents page reads credentials only for its own placed agents; an agent named with its instance, <handle>#<id>, handle and #id two links, instances offered by the @ picker; agents are added on the project's Agents, open joins as seats under the cards; a member adds their own agents on Agents only where the hub sends member_agents, counted per agent; the team rulebook on the agent's card on Agents and in its Manage row, for its owner only; an agent's picture on its card on Agents and in its Manage row; one's agents on /agents in the gear menu, added to a project through its join panel; an agent profile deleted where it is managed, confirmed by its handle, its projects named first; whom an agent reports to chosen in the join panel, for one already here its owner's PATCH before the join; a dormant instance said with its address wherever it is shown, put to rest in the Manage row and on Agents; an agent started on a runner from Agents' Where they run, on one's own live runners only
board.md: a board card ends in one row of controls; a card opens as a panel on the board, not a page of its own; a note edited in place in the card panel, an open edit kept across a redraw of the list, Remove asking its reason as a chat removal does, Add a note drawn once per panel and the list locked while it is read; a report's why links its file at the reported head; a subtask stands folded under its parent, whatever its column; a card opened on the board reads what its panel needs, never the list again; the board reads its column groups side by side; on a phone an opened card is a page of its own, the panel is the card; before a way into the restricted-access set the page says who will read, no more than the reader is served
chat.md: the chat list is no header row, names wrap whole, a line says who it is; the global chat updates from the notifications stream, never a project's events feed, at once only for a chat or mention in it or a moved chat count, the rest on its 30-second round; the header's Chat badge is the hub's unread chat messages, #/chats reads every project when it opens; the global chat names an agent's projects by logo, from the reader's own member lists; the keys that send beside the send button, as the keyboard prints them; a chat opens on its newest page in two requests, older pages on scroll-up; the lead reached by a Lead button beside Chat, no strip, on a phone from the Chats page; a chat with an agent sends to the whole team unless one instance is chosen beside its heading; a chat's composer hides for reading on a phone and grows 2× or 3× on a wide screen, kept per browser; a chat fills the window from where it starts, less what stands below it, "Sending…" in the composer's row; on a phone a chat shows less around it (the product line's first part, no "In it:" line, the composer's label out of sight), and any chat takes the whole window until the button, Escape or back, the button at the head's top right on a phone, no session line there; a message's seq copies as the number alone, its # drawn by the stylesheet; the chat lists' pin buttons a mode: hidden on every load, stored nowhere
inbox.md: the inbox is the first screen, then board, agents, organisation, chat, Memory; a personal request's project, card and mentions are no links, its people linked by the member list; a personal request may carry no project; a report's request in the inbox only opens the report; the inbox is the requests alone, activity on the bell, the Chat button and /notifications; a request the hub files is Maity's, the not-listening digest and its bell item lead to /agents; Send and Talk on every request one can answer, disabled with the reason where the hub would refuse them; a project's inbox reads its open requests first, the answered ones only on Show or a link
jour-fixe.md: the jour fixe a tab of its own with its rounds and what each reader may do under one; its series are kept in Project settings and the tab groups its rounds by series, each with its start, opt-out and report switches
members.md: the org tree is computed, never stored; every member named through one helper, as a link; an agent's credentials, briefing and pause in its Manage row on Members for an admin, one's own agents on the project's Agents; trust and role shown and chosen as the hub keeps them, owner-only choices offered to owners only; every role of §2.3 from one list, by its label, its help under the picker; a project's Members a neutral list with Chat, its Agents one's own agents with the /agents component, the organisation on the Team page; an invitation's link via the join host offered only where the hub names one; a member's page is for reading, its Actions menu only leads to Members or Agents; an agent's owner sets whom it reports to without members:admin, a boss of another owner marked as waiting for consent, no Withdraw until the contract shows a pending edge; a member's Activity reads the hub's latest 5000 events and says so; Members filters to one's own agents with Only my agents, kept per viewer in the browser; an agent isolated from its Manage row with a reason and a confirmation, an Isolated badge on the list; a consent line names who is asked and calls saved only what the member, read again, already has; the organisation's Paths face draws only edges the members API gives, an event's usual edges marked as usual; the Agents page's Organisation tab the same tree, one's own agents only under oneself, someone else's boss a stub
memory.md: a preference proposal reviewed as an inline diff, a stale one merged by hand; the memory provider changed in Project settings with a reason, the commitment following it; the Keep the Why personal settings are left out under no memory provider and show no values
messages.md: project messages read page by page from the hub's listing (§8.8), the feed only the signal; a review result shows its verdict, head and cites in Messages, the dashboard composes none
organisations.md: organisations under #/account/orgs, not #/orgs; a suspended organisation's handle and page locked in the form; the organisation's handle in the address read as a typed one; the fixture hub's reserved handles a copy of the hub's; the fixture hub serves an organisation's page by its switch, the hub not yet; New project offers an organisation as owner only where the hub takes it and the human may create there; a transfer into an organisation moves at once only for its owner
overview.md: the overview leads with what needs the reader, its badge shown there and changed in Settings; the Overview in three tabs, Summary, Swarm and Project, the organisation a tab of the Team page; the swarm statistics the Overview's Swarm tab, read on their own, no project tab, no public page
people.md: a person or an organisation at /<handle> is one read of GET /people/{handle}, a placeholder where no picture is given
runners.md: runners in the gear menu, not the projects' row
settings.md: a project's name changed in Project settings, a card outside its project read with it; one Settings view per project, Project for its admins and Mine at settings/mine; a project's own links beside the repository, which reads Repository whatever the forge, the form sending only what changed
shell.md: a project switcher everywhere and the cross-project inbox as landing page; the dashboard asks the hub no capability question, a missing route is an error; at phone width the header text beside the logo is hidden from sight only; the header with the lockup is static in the page, loading and failure centred under it; a project keyed by its full name everywhere, the old /p/<slug> gone without a redirect; the project banner at 2:1, the shape of a forge's social preview; the view being left is inert until the next one is drawn; the project's repository and Keep the Why dashboard as links beside its state; All projects has two pages, Inbox and Chats, each with its count; a project's unread mentions a link beside its tabs, to /notifications filtered to the project; the frame's stylesheets on only where the sign-in or registration stands signed out, its header and footer beside the app's; no New project tab, it is the last item of "+" after Agent, User and Runner, the tabs menu right after the tabs, at the row's right end on a phone, a dragged tab's place a line by the drop's own half; the boot reads the window and the session together, /me still after the session; a handle field's hint is a sentence of fixed words, nothing filled in, at most two lines on a phone
ticker.md: the Ticker reads the listing, reasons in words; the ticker's contract implementers edited as lines of text
why.md: a Keep the Why notice leads to the project's Members or to one's agents on the account; the project's Why tab mounts the Keep the Why views, loaded on the first visit, their words English and translate="no" for now
